_comment: Cross-layer convergence baseline (tools/raman_saab/cross_layer_report.py). Compares each varga's INDEPENDENT status (confirms/weakens, from the divisional chart) to the D1 rollup of its related house(s). HONEST READING: the OVERALL agreement is only marginally above chance because the naive confirms<->favourable mapping is doctrinally ambiguous for dusthana-governed vargas (D30->6/8: a 'favourable 8th' has inverted polarity). The MEANINGFUL signal is D9 Navamsa (the one varga wired into the D1 verdict via _navamsa_status): it corroborates strongly (76% of polar cases). The overall rate is used only as a non-tautology + regression guard; d9_polar_agreement is the real convergence assertion. Captured on soul-destiny-experiment over 192 goldens / 1278 signalled pairs. RE-BASED 2026-10-23 (engine audit, deliberate): d9_polar_agreement 0.7294 -> 0.6693, agreement_rate 0.4753 -> 0.4692. Two audit fixes lower it by design: (1) the one-sided-rasi navamsa guard stops the D9 lifting a malefic-only 'mixed' to favourable (and the mirror), so D9 no longer manufactures the D1 verdict it is then compared against — part of the old agreement was that circularity; (2) the house rollup no longer reports 'mixed' over an afflicted sub-matter, which changes the D1 rollup this harness compares to. hard_rate fell 0.4027 -> 0.3937.
_comment_2026_10_24: 2026-10-24 re-base (NAVAMSA ONE-STEP RULE, user decision): agreement_rate 0.4692 -> 0.4203, total_signalled 1460 -> 2310, hard_rate 0.3937 -> 0.3385. The D1 verdict no longer lets the Navamsa carry it two steps, so D1 leans less often toward what the vargas say; that agreement had partly been the D9 writing the D1 answer. Hard contradictions FELL. d9_polar_agreement still passes.
